semanticDecisions: the query is a necessary condition only; Matcher's existing gate evaluates it over exact UTF-16 trigram facts of [from, to) and a false result skips the engine with the same observable state as a failed Start/BnM search (hitEnd true, requireEnd false, no match)

requireEnd writers (Dollar, UnixDollar, Bound, GraphemeBound, Neg) and Begin/First-rooted patterns are refused so no observable Matcher state can differ; \G (LastMatch) compiles under a Start root and is admitted

lookaround contents, back references, character classes and min-0 repetitions are unconstrained; adjacent literal runs across empty-width group nodes are joined; alternatives are OR-ed and an empty alternative removes the alternation's requirement
a derivation failure of any kind (RuntimeException or OutOfMemoryError) leaves m3Tq null; Pattern.compile gains no failure mode
